onboarding.title: Getting Started
onboarding.desc: Five steps to a minimally usable setup. Progress is derived from live data; you can resume later.
onboarding.allDone: Everything is ready. You can finish the guide.
onboarding.inProgress: Complete the remaining steps to finish.
onboarding.finishHint: Some steps are still incomplete. Configure them first or choose Later.
onboarding.dismissed: Guide hidden. Use Restart to show it again.
onboarding.note: State is stored in this browser; it reappears on another device or after clearing storage. Checks are read-only.

hints.security: Password state looks good; enabling 2FA is recommended

org.title: Create an organization
org.desc: Create at least one organization to own subnets, addresses and permissions.

subnet.title: Plan DHCP subnets
subnet.desc: Add IPv4/IPv6 subnets and pools; changes are applied automatically.

upstream.title: Configure DNS upstreams
upstream.desc: Set default recursive/forwarding upstreams for name resolution.

records.title: Add DNS zones and records
records.desc: Create an authoritative/local zone and at least one record.

security.title: Confirm account security
security.desc: Make sure the initial password is handled; enabling 2FA is recommended.

onboarding.bannerDesc: Five steps to set up subnets, DNS and account security. Progress is auto-detected.
